g01.line: Welcome to planet Maya, Captain. I'm Sergeant Wilhelm of Merchant Corp.
g01.speaker: Wilhelm

g02.line: I know you're coming to our planet for the first time, and your skills will come in handy.
g02.speaker: Wilhelm

g03.line: Here at Merchant Corp, we gather resources like lumber, oil, and other rare resources, then sell them to people on other planets.
g03.speaker: Wilhelm

g04.line: However, it's getting harder to find these resources. That's why we need you to help us.
g04.speaker: Wilhelm

g05.line: We've just found Fortuna. No team has explored it.
g05.speaker: Wilhelm

g06.line: It's far from our main base. It may have oil, gold, and useful wood. But storms and wild animals may make the trip dangerous.
g06.speaker: Wilhelm VO

g07.line: Explore Fortuna and report what you find. If the resources are there and the site is safe, we'll ask you to build a base and start collecting them.
g07.speaker: Wilhelm

g08.line: You'll lead your own crew, build your own base, and get ten percent of the profit after costs. That's the money left after costs. Will you take the mission?
g08.speaker: Wilhelm
